author: Josan
description: A tangy-sweet North Indian summer drink made from raw mangoes, sugar, and spices — known for its cooling properties.
instructions: Boil or roast the raw mangoes until soft. Let them cool, then peel and extract the pulp.
In a blender, add mango pulp, sugar, cumin powder, black salt, regular salt, and mint leaves.
Add cold water and ice cubes, then blend again to mix.
Serve chilled with a mint garnish or a sprinkle of cumin powder.
